name: motion-card-fan
title: Card Stack Fan
description: Ba thẻ chồng nhau xoè ra: thẻ dưới sang phải, thẻ trên cùng sang trái, mỗi thẻ nghiêng 18° bằng lò xo lệch nhịp, chỉ thẻ trên cùng vượt quá rồi về; sau đó gom lại.

moworks.author: moworks

options.cards: cards from the bottom of the stack to the top
options.each: s between cards (0.06; the top card last)
options.c: [others, top card] damping ([22, 12]: only the top card overshoots)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 3 cards 80x110 r10 (top accent, middle blue, bottom light) stacked at the centre, each rotating about its own centre. Card k spreads by v = spring(k220): x (k − 1) × 70 px and rotation (k − 1) × 0.32 rad (±18°), the middle card stays. Starts: bottom card 0.3 s, middle 0.36 s, top 0.42 s (60 ms apart); only the top card is underdamped (c12, ≈ 25 % overshoot), the others c22. Close 2.3-2.7 s power2.inOut. Recipe: ~600 ms springs, 40 ms apart, 8-15°. Params: spread (±70 px, ±18°) · each (0.06 s, thẻ trên cùng sau cùng) · top (k220 c12) · others (k220 c22) · close (0.4 s).
moworks.titleVi: Chồng thẻ xoè ra hai bên
